invariant: A state transition label is a Display block, not a scalar SVG text node. CommandLinkStateCommon calls Display.getWithNewlines before constructing LinkArg. Outside raw <math>, <latex>, and [[link]] spans, legacy \\n, \\l, and \\r terminate the current row; \\l and \\r also select the Display's natural horizontal alignment, \\t becomes a tab, and \\\\ becomes one literal backslash. The resulting ordered rows and block-wide alignment are consumed by one SheetBlock1/TextBlock for both pre-layout dimensions and final painting. SvekEdge supplies stateMessageAlignment, which falls back through defaultTextAlignment to CENTER, and Display's explicit natural alignment overrides it. Block width is the maximum row width, block height is the sum of row heights, and each row is placed according to that effective alignment within the maximum width. The first row uses the resolved StateArrowFont first-baseline ascent; subsequent row baselines advance by the measured row heights. Every state rendering path must size, route, paint, and bound the same parsed block.
causal_divergence: Rust keeps the captured transition label as an opaque String and every state label consumer measures and emits it as one logical row. A source label such as `boot pass\\nsecond line` therefore becomes one SVG text element containing the two backslash characters instead of two Display rows. This inflates the Graphviz label width, collapses the label height, changes solved routing space, emits the wrong glyph content, and produces incorrect painted bounds. Fixing only SVG emission would leave layout and bounds inconsistent; replacing every `\\n` blindly in text_render would corrupt raw math/link content and unrelated diagram families. The divergence is the absence of PlantUML's state-transition Display value model at the parser-renderer boundary.
planned_change: Introduce a typed state-transition Display representation owned by the parser diagram model: ordered row strings plus a block-wide natural alignment. Parse the Java legacy escapes with raw-mode boundaries matching Display.getWithNewlines, including \\n, \\l, \\r, \\t, and \\\\, while preserving unknown escapes and raw math, latex, and link content. Retain Option<String>-equivalent source absence and string serialization semantics without allowing renderers to reinterpret the raw command text independently. Resolve the base block alignment from stateMessageAlignment, then defaultTextAlignment, then CENTER; let the Display's natural alignment override it. In the state renderer, build one shared measured label-block value from the parsed rows and resolved StateArrowFont. Use it in ordinary and SVEK box sizing, all layout requests, autonomous and flat painted bounds, and both label emission paths. Emit each row through text_render::emit_text, advance baselines by family-aware row height, and align rows inside the maximum measured width using the effective Display alignment. Preserve Graphviz padding, SvekEdge margins, solved origins, Creole run styling, arrow geometry, DPI scaling, and oracle-assisted captured-label handling. Do not add fixture-label checks, per-row coordinate constants, or post-hoc SVG rewriting.

scope_boundary: This mechanism owns parsing, dimensions, row placement, and painted bounds for state transition Display rows. It does not own transition font-family selection, pseudostate paint, arrow routing algorithms, state body text, labels in other diagram families, or raw math/latex rendering beyond preventing legacy escape splitting inside their spans.
